# Vendored spec artifacts

Copied from the accessible `pa-spec-dev` working tree by `npm run sync:specs`.
This includes uncommitted spec edits. These files are a reference copy of the
spec — material to consult and trace against, not a gate on development — and
are refreshed by `npm run sync:specs` rather than hand-edited. API versions
remain in `SPEC_VERSION`/`CONTEST_SPEC_VERSION`.
